title: Arabic Rhetoric I  Bayan
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the particle (adat al-tashbīh) and lā yanfaku dhā kadar, is wajh al-shibah."
The kaf is the particle (adat al-tashbīh) and lā yanfaku dhā kadar, is wajh al-shibah.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means failure to observe the rule of balāgha."
Failure to observe context means failure to observe the rule of balāgha.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vital aspect human civilization."
Language is a vital aspect human civilization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the similitude of people who falsify the Signs of Allah, and Allah guided not people who do wrong."
Evil is the similitude of people who falsify the Signs of Allah, and Allah guided not people who do wrong.
fib: ______ is a symbol of correctness and accuracy, and the opinion of the teacher is so designated.
The scale is a symbol of correctness and accuracy, and the opinion of the teacher is so designated.
______ is the best writer whenever his pen drinks from his inkpot or sings on his paper.
Ahmad is the best writer whenever his pen drinks from his inkpot or sings on his paper.
______ is the devil incarnate, I love her so much.
My wife is the devil incarnate, I love her so much.
